description: Use when a trading agent needs one call covering perp state, funding, OI and news sentiment for many coins. One-call perps + news market scan for trading agents ($0.01/call, USDC on Base via x402). For the default set (watchlist + coins in the news, up to 25) or 1-20 symbols you pass: Hyperliquid mark, oracle, 24h change, funding hourly/8h/annualized, open interest USD, 24h volume, premium, extreme-funding rank, joined with news sentiment, headline attention vs 7-day average and neutral flags. Facts only. Errors are not charged. Example: GET https://cryptofeed402.site/perps/context?symbols=BTC,ETH
